MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The clear epoxy fits my occasional repair needs because it adds a clear-bond option alongside the tape and vinyl cement I have bought.",
    "Heat-shrink tubing and sealed splice connectors complement my existing quick-disconnect terminals by helping insulate connections or join wires in a different way."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs require particular cable gauges and stud sizes; my small-wire terminal purchase gives me no reason to need those sizes.",
    "The cutting wheels and feeler gauge assume specific equipment or tasks I have not indicated, while electronic cleaner addresses a different need from connecting wires.",
    "The additional steel-reinforced epoxies overlap with the clear epoxy I selected, and the large pack feels unnecessary without a particular repair in mind."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My clamp and connector purchases seem to have been taken as a broad interest in metalworking and heavy battery wiring.",
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to buy several epoxy formulations at once, although I would choose one suited to the repair."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact compatibility matters: a connector needs to fit the wire and attachment point, not simply resemble electrical supplies I already own.",
    "I am more interested in supplies that add a useful repair capability than in specialized tools or larger quantities without an identified task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specialized tasks and overlapping supplies I do not currently need."
}
